description: This file implements the SetPlaybackRate class, which manages changing the playback rate of a media pipeline in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes logic to handle different pipeline states, interacts with GStreamer elements and events, and logs various stages of execution.

classes.name: SetPlaybackRate
classes.description: A class responsible for setting the playback rate of a media pipeline, handling different pipeline states, and sending appropriate GStreamer events.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetPlaybackRate object with context, wrappers, and target rate.

methods.name: ~SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the SetPlaybackRate task.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the action of setting the playback rate, including checks for current rate, pipeline state, and sending appropriate GStreamer events.
